title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: Your assistant's program has just made model call 2 in a conversation with a student. What does the model carry over from call 1 into call 2?

options.text: Everything it read in call 1, held inside the model itself
Only a short summary that the model writes by itself
Only what the program sends again as part of call 2
Nothing, so each call sees only the newest message

items.stem: An agent run makes three model calls. Call 1 reads 550 tokens (system prompt, tool descriptions and the question). After call 1 the model writes a 30-token tool request, and the tool result is 400 tokens. After call 2 the model writes another 30-token tool request, and that tool result is 1,000 tokens. Call 3 writes the final answer. Each call reads the whole history so far. How many input tokens are read in total across the three calls?
Your makerspace assistant must answer questions from twelve machine manuals totalling about 600 pages. Which design fits best, given a small model budget?

options.text: Put all twelve manuals in the system prompt on every call
Put only the manuals' tables of contents in the context
Rely on the model to recall the manuals from training
Search the manuals and return only the best few passages

items.stem: On Monday a student tells your assistant they finished the laser cutter training. On Wednesday, in a new session, the assistant asks them again. In one or two sentences, why does this happen, and what change to the program fixes it?
A model with a very large context window is available. Give one reason, other than the window being full, to keep the assistant's context small anyway.
